metadataRaw.title: 7 Ways to Instantly Stop Hiccups
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates how to instantly stop hiccups.

Hiccups occur due to involuntary spasms of the diaphragm, the muscle that helps you breathe. To stop them, it's important to stimulate the vagus nerve, which controls the diaphragm, and relax the diaphragm to eliminate the spasms.

This video presents seven effective methods, each working differently. For the best results, try them all and use the one that provides the most relief.

As a bonus, no equipment is needed, and these techniques may stop hiccups in as little as 30 seconds.

Watch now and get fast hiccups relief!
